HANDOFF.md.content:
# K64 QK + two-term TF32 PV: operator-only gate

One private operator build. No GPU execution, broad interpreter build, production edits or scheduling change. Existing sliding24-job queue is untouched.

Candidate math: retained K64 QK, same FP32 softmax/correction/merge, P_hi=RN_TF32(P), P_lo=RN_TF32(P-P_hi), then low×BF16V and high×BF16V MMA contributions into original FP32 output accumulator. Signed low residual is retained. V staging remains the same64-row cp.async tile, identical waits/barriers and tail zero fill. BF16P packing is skipped; allocated arena still126592bytes. B1/HD512/GQA16/NS33 gives33 useful tasks on132CTAs; underfill remains explicit.

Actual CPU resource gate: candidateHD512/GF16=124registers/0spills/0stack vs originalBF16PV121. HD512/GF8=85,HD256/GF6=80, zero spills. SASS shows32BF16 QK HMMA plus128TF32 PV HMMA; unchanged merge and scalar fallback instruction text. Compiler emits one unusedPS constant warning because BF16 probability packing is bypassed; no compilation error. Source-isolation proof confirms all code outside privatePV helper region is byte-identical to K64source. No register cap applied.

Coordinates are cross-checked with NVIDIA PTX m16n8k8 TF32 formulas and local CUTLASS SM80 traits. A: row=lane/4+8*(element%2), K=lane%4+4*(element/2). B: K=lane%4+4*element, N=lane/4. Accumulator mapping matches the existing kernel. CPU195shape/tailcases include all0..64 live rows forHD512/GF16,HD512/GF8,HD256/GF6; signed residual and nearest-even checks pass;65,280finiteBF16 bit patterns are exactly representable inTF32. These prove indexing/representation, not GPU accumulation or subnormal execution behavior.

Primary source: https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution/index.html#warp-level-matrix-fragment-mma-1688
Local reference: /opt/pytorch/lib/python3.13/site-packages/tilelang/3rdparty/cutlass/include/cute/atom/mma_traits_sm80.hpp:163 and cute/arch/mma_sm80.hpp:290.

The single queue job reuses qwen_primitives saved-native mode and the qualified explicit-primary-context launcher. Three actual captured native histories × originalBF16PV/candidate =six cells, each with two exact repeats, finite/outercanary checks and unchanged .003 native bound. Control merged output must match the captured originalBF16PV broad output. Both arms write all Opart/MLpart/BF16 outputs. No FA or timing calls occur.

The explicit CPU validator verifies provenance/library identity and recomputes normalized per-split FP64 reference on exact savedQKV. It requires fewer total RNE mismatches than originalBF16PV, no per-history mismatch-count regression, and at least2× reduction in worst normalized-partial relative error. This is an additional experiment advancement criterion, not a relaxed original gate. It preserves full diagnostic rows even if accuracy improvement fails. Initial histories have limited synthetic V diversity; no full-model accuracy claim.

Root runs gpu-queue.json serially then its explicit validator. GPU memory and timing remain subsequent gates; do not build broad until this numeric/resource result is reviewed.

import hashlib, importlib.util, json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
R=Path(__file__).parent
A=R.parent/"e1-qk-numerical-audit-20260906"
def module(name,path):
 spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m);return m
C=module("compare",A/"compare-block.py"); F=module("reference",A/"float64-reference.py")
def check_improvement(rows):
 control_rne=sum(r["arms"]["control"]["rne_mismatches"] for r in rows)
 candidate_rne=sum(r["arms"]["candidate"]["rne_mismatches"] for r in rows)
 assert len(rows)==3 and candidate_rne < control_rne, ("no BF16 rounding accuracy improvement",candidate_rne,control_rne)
 assert all(r["arms"]["candidate"]["rne_mismatches"]<=r["arms"]["control"]["rne_mismatches"] for r in rows)
 assert max(r["arms"]["candidate"]["normalized_partial_vs_fp64"]["relative_l2"] for r in rows) < .5*max(r["arms"]["control"]["normalized_partial_vs_fp64"]["relative_l2"] for r in rows), "no substantive partial precision improvement"
 return control_rne,candidate_rne
for path,spec in json.loads((R/"saved-input-provenance.json").read_text()).items():
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==spec["sha256"],path
for path,spec in json.loads((R/"FREEZE.json").read_text())["files"].items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((R/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==spec["sha256"],path
report=json.loads((R/"results/operator-numerical.json").read_text()); assert report["passed"] and len(report["rows"])==6
for arm,name in [("control","bf16-pv-control.so"),("candidate","k64-tf32-pv.so")]:
 assert Path(report["libraries"][arm]["path"])==R/name
 assert report["libraries"][arm]["sha256"]==hashlib.sha256((R/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

native=C.load("control"); old=C.load("qk-pv"); rows=[]
for step in range(3):
 raw,c=native[step]; length=1025+step
 q=c["act.q"].reshape(16,512).astype(np.float64); k=c["kv.5.k"].reshape(length,512).astype(np.float64); v=c["kv.5.v"].reshape(length,512).astype(np.float64)
 logs=(q@k.T)*float(np.float32(1.4426950408889634)); ideal_o=np.empty((16,33,512)); ideal_ml=np.empty((16,33,2)); per=(length+32)//33
 for s in range(33):
  lo=s*per;hi=min(lo+per,length);assert lo<hi
  mx=logs[:,lo:hi].max(1); p=np.exp2(logs[:,lo:hi]-mx[:,None]);ideal_ml[:,s,0]=mx;ideal_ml[:,s,1]=p.sum(1);ideal_o[:,s]=p@v[lo:hi]
 ref=np.fromfile(A/f"reference-step{step}.f64",dtype="<f8").reshape(16,512); rn=F.bf16(ref,"rne")
 row=dict(step=step,length=length,arms={})
 for arm in ["scalar","control","candidate"]:
  if arm=="scalar": out=c["act.at"].reshape(16,512); bits=np.frombuffer(raw["act.at"],dtype="<u2").reshape(16,512);op=c["act.opart"].reshape(16,33,512).astype(np.float64);ml=c["act.mlpart"].reshape(16,33,2).astype(np.float64)
  else:
   record=next(r for r in report["rows"] if r["step"]==step and r["arm"]==arm)
   bits=np.fromfile(record["out_file"],dtype="<u2").reshape(16,512);out=F.decode(bits);op=np.fromfile(record["opart_file"],dtype="<f4").reshape(16,33,512).astype(np.float64);ml=np.fromfile(record["mlpart_file"],dtype="<f4").reshape(16,33,2).astype(np.float64)
   if arm=="control":
    assert Path(record["out_file"]).read_bytes()==old[step][0]["act.at"],(step,"original broad/DSO output mismatch")
  assert np.isfinite(op).all() and np.isfinite(ml).all() and (ml[:,:,1]>0).all()
  entry=dict(output_vs_fp64=C.metrics(ref,out),normalized_partial_vs_fp64=C.metrics(ideal_o/ideal_ml[:,:,1,None],op/ml[:,:,1,None]),maxima_vs_fp64=C.metrics(ideal_ml[:,:,0],ml[:,:,0]),sums_vs_fp64=C.metrics(ideal_ml[:,:,1],ml[:,:,1]),rne_mismatches=int(np.count_nonzero(bits!=rn)),native=C.metrics(c["act.at"].reshape(16,512),out),changed_words=[])
  for h,d in np.argwhere(out!=old[step][1]["act.at"].reshape(16,512)):
   entry["changed_words"].append(dict(head=int(h),dimension=int(d),reference=float(ref[h,d]),rne=float(F.decode(rn)[h,d]),old_bf16_pv=float(old[step][1]["act.at"].reshape(16,512)[h,d]),actual=float(out[h,d])))
  row["arms"][arm]=entry
 rows.append(row)
failure=None
try:control_rne,candidate_rne=check_improvement(rows)
except AssertionError as e:
 failure=str(e)
 control_rne=sum(r["arms"]["control"]["rne_mismatches"] for r in rows)
 candidate_rne=sum(r["arms"]["candidate"]["rne_mismatches"] for r in rows)
result=dict(passed=failure is None,failure=failure,decision="Operator accuracy improvement PASS; broad build requires root review" if failure is None else "HOLD: accuracy criterion failed",scope="Three captured native synthetic-prefix histories; no timing/full-model qualification",rows=rows,words=24576,original_bf16_pv_rne_mismatches=control_rne,candidate_rne_mismatches=candidate_rne,notes=["Unchanged BF16QKV,scale1,NS33,FP32softmax/merge", "Candidate K64QK+two-termTF32PV; controloriginalBF16PV", "RNE mismatches must decrease, no per-history mismatch regression, max normalized-partial error must improve at least2x", "Fixed native.003 gate remains separate and unchanged"])

(R/"accuracy-analysis.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
for r in rows:
 print(r["step"],[(a,round(e["normalized_partial_vs_fp64"]["relative_l2"],12),e["maxima_vs_fp64"]["max_abs"],e["rne_mismatches"]) for a,e in r["arms"].items()])

if failure:raise SystemExit(1)
